gameplay-l2.note: Direct-write game. No solenoid moves in 40 s of attract mode. Start serves with 2, resets the 3-bank with 4 and sets 23. Specials follow their switches. Holding 82 sets 44 and 45/46; holding 84 sets 47/48 and leaves 44 at 0. Completing SORCERER flashes 7 and 8 and blinks GI 11; completing the 3-bank resets it (4) and rings the bell (15). A ball resting in the lock (37) makes the ROM serve the next ball (2) with flashers 5 and 8; a second ball resting on the ramp switch (38) fires the multi-ball eject (3). Each outhole closure kicks 1, and after both balls drain the ROM serves ball 2. One playfield-tilt closure drops 23. Lamp 22 is dark until S-O-R-C-E-R-E-R is complete, then lit until the 3-bank is completed, which clears it and lights lamp 23, still lit while ball 2 is in play: by the manual's rules 22 behaves as DEMON and 23 as BONUS HELD OVER (named_output_addresses). Solenoid 8 flashes with game effects and is never held through play. No output the manual prints Not Used moves.

solenoid-test-l2.limitation: The manual's procedure says the match display sequences 01 through 25 and that sub-test 25 de-energizes the flipper relay; this ROM steps 01-16 only, so the test does not exercise the game-on enable 23.
